visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Page shows the log too early
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The page should show the three log entries, but it only shows the first one. The text is written right away, before the promise and the timer have run.

solution.explanation: The line that writes the text runs immediately, when the log only has now. Promises and timers finish later, so the text must be written after them, for example in a later timer or at the end of a promise chain.
